alignment.accounting: sum of training, validation, diagnostics and failed/timeout worker durations; final test separately reported as in run2.sh
alignment.trial_limit_policy: cap 1.5 * 10800 seconds, prorate remaining shared budget before concurrent dispatch
alignment.llm_reference_difference: RecHarness native GLM orchestrator and Claude Code implementation transport both replaced with the identical Codex gpt-6.1-sol/medium transport used by the other three methods.
alignment.search_scope: eight GRU4Rec edit directions under four parent categories; cross-category two-direction combination jumps; single-model candidates only
alignment.execution_isolation: trusted local processes; test directory omitted from training environment, not an OS filesystem jail

recharness.implementation: isolated native RecHarness jump-v3 semantic-arm fork with aligned GPU executor

jump_policy.scope: Amazon Reviews matched experiments; model family remains constrained by original prompts
jump_policy.global_budget_change: none; reservation and all failed attempts are charged within the existing cap
jump_policy.local_promotion: compare against current basin incumbent; preserve monotone global validation history
jump_policy.trial_cap: ceil(max(min_trial_seconds + 5, p75(last 32 positive measured trial costs) * 1.25 + 5))
jump_policy.retune_group_size: largest integer in 1..4 whose jump plus four retune groups fit the protected envelope
jump_policy.acceptance: retune best validation score strictly exceeds pre-jump global incumbent
jump_policy.incomplete_window: restore old incumbent unless already exceeded; no delayed alpha/beta credit
jump_policy.comparison: same data, evaluator, LLM and total GPU budget for jump on/off; exploration trigger is logged explicitly
jump_policy.jump_type: exactly two edit directions from different parent categories in one jointly trained GRU model
jump_policy.normal_reward: strict validation improvement over the group-start basin incumbent
jump_policy.category_credit: pair reward only; no component credit

baseline.correction: Select last nonpadding recurrent state for the left-padded GRU histories
baseline.origin: upstream GRU4Rec template; no historical evolved candidate or trained weights

recharness.transport: same gpt-6.1-sol/medium; three retries then cooldown at the same pending request; process-group cleanup
recharness.selection: native incumbent after safe jump finalization; validation only; final held-out test once
recharness.single_model: independent prediction fusion disallowed; audit is charged within each GPU trial

gru_baseline.correction: Select last nonpadding recurrent state for the left-padded GRU histories
gru_baseline.origin: upstream GRU4Rec template; no historical evolved candidate or trained weights

feature_construction.label: 特征构造
feature_construction.scope: Construct input features solely from supplied training interactions, such as frequency or recency indicators. No external metadata, independent scorer or score fusion. Keep learned embedding design, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer fixed.

embedding_representation.label: 嵌入表征
embedding_representation.scope: Item embedding dimensions, parameterization, tying and embedding normalization. Keep feature definitions, interaction/scoring mechanism, GRU topology, history policy, loss and optimizer fixed.

interaction_mechanism.label: 交互机制
interaction_mechanism.scope: Jointly trained user-interest/item interaction or scoring mechanisms, such as gated or bilinear compatibility. Preserve the recurrent backbone topology, input features, history readout, loss and optimizer. No independently trained score fusion.

network_architecture.label: 网络架构
network_architecture.scope: GRU depth, recurrent gates, residual paths and internal network topology. Retain the GRU recurrent backbone. Preserve input features, embedding design, scoring mechanism, history selection/readout, loss and optimizer.

sequence_modeling.label: 序列建模
sequence_modeling.scope: Causal input context length, truncation and ordering/position representation. Preserve input feature definitions, embedding design, GRU topology, interest readout, loss and optimizer. Never introduce future interactions or change supplied splits.

interest_aggregation.label: 兴趣聚合
interest_aggregation.scope: Readout of existing recurrent states, such as last-state, mean, recency-weighted or attention pooling, inside one jointly trained model. Preserve input history selection, embedding construction, backbone topology, scoring mechanism, loss and optimizer.

learning_objective.label: 学习目标
learning_objective.scope: Ranking/prediction loss, loss weighting and jointly trained auxiliary objectives. Preserve feature definitions, embeddings, GRU topology, scoring/readout, optimizer, sampling, scheduler and batch/epoch settings.

training_strategy.label: 训练策略
training_strategy.scope: Optimizer, learning rate, batch size, scheduler, dropout and weight decay. Preserve model structure, features, scoring/readout and loss definition. Keep seed 42, epoch cap 200, data splits, evaluation and GPU/CPU allocation fixed.

arm_policy.regular_routing: one TS draw for each of eight directions; select the top four without replacement for four GPUs
arm_policy.gpu_budget_allocation: selection frequency allocates slots over rounds; equal per-candidate caps within a group; charge actual worker duration
arm_policy.regular_reward: Bernoulli success iff valid host validation strictly exceeds the group-start local incumbent
arm_policy.jump_routing: budget-safe gate; draw from the eight direction posteriors; combine highest draw with highest cross-parent compatible draw; G=1
arm_policy.jump_credit: one delayed combination_jump outcome counter; no unidentifiable component-direction credit and no separate prior for each pair
arm_policy.edit_contract: exact selected direction set, per-direction nontrivial AST edits, logged rationale; semantic scope prompt-enforced
